text:
Riley: Dropped a minimal mock for the "diff timeline" widget in Figma — scrubber + stacked markers + hover previews. Need quick UX + a11y nits before I hand to eng.
Kai: Quick visual: active marker contrast is low on the light canvas. bump to a darker blue or add a 2px white outline.
Priya: Keyboard: left/right to step, home/end jump, Enter opens details. show a visible focus ring and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Devon: Overlapping markers are noisy; suggest cluster pill like "+N" that expands an inline list on click. keep individual hover to show snippet.
Marta: Copy nit: primary button reads `Show changes` — too vague. propose `View regression details`. resolved state should read "No regression detected".
Riley: Good. also add a small deep-link: "Open in scorecard" that anchors to the eval row. helps reviewers jump to approval flow.
Kai: For screen readers: add aria-live announcements like "Selected diff 2 of 7: regression in test signup-flow" and an offscreen label with keyboard hints.
Priya: Colors: don't rely on color alone; badging needs icons + text fallback. ensure 3:1 contrast on badges or use patterned backgrounds.
Devon: Mobile: scrubber touch target >=44px, allow swipe to move, truncate long test names with ellipsis and reveal full name on tap.
EvalBot: automated note — eval run 1903 attached. summary: 11 diffs, 4 regressions. PR #434 will wire timeline events.
Marta: Animation: 120ms fade for tooltips, but disable animations when reduced-motion is set. focus ring should be 3px in high-contrast mode.
Riley: I'll update the Figma + spec with aria snippets, compact/expanded height toggle, and the cluster pill behavior. will post PR for quick review. :rocket:
